# Spiritual Translation: The Sea Giant

---

**¶2:** After the Divine operating through spiritual power had ordered all the states of the mind and their encompassing spiritual environments, it descended and established its presence in the natural degree of the mind. It communicated its intent to the Divine governing faculty, which set in motion the three cyclical orders of providence, causing those cycles that exist [GAP-1: the spiritual sense requires cycles of providential order operating] above the highest states of love and elevation. The Divine directed spiritual influx toward them, breathed the life of the spirit into them, stirred them to activity, and purified the natural mind with truths. And the accumulated falsities of the three containing forms — those of truth, of ignorance-from-evil, and of self-love — which had been deposited into the natural mind, the Divine gathered and placed into the general repository of natural cognition enclosed within its own boundaries and vessels. This is why such gathered knowledges are desolate: they received their desolation and bitterness from the purging and cleansing of the three containing forms.

---

**¶3:** When the Divine as the source of all spiritual life ascended, withdrawing into the inmost degrees, it released the cycle of discrete knowledges from its impurities, purifying it and loosening all the gross falsity that had settled within it. It cast those falsities down into the great interior repository of natural cognition, as [GAP-2: the spiritual sense requires something precipitated from] the elevated state. And that refuse — the sediment of the purification of the cycle of knowledges — was cast down and mingled with the mass of natural cognition. The inherent organizing will within that mass collected the refuse together, and this formative intention gathered the waste in this manner: it compacted and consolidated it [GAP-3: the spiritual sense requires fixation into a definite and enduring form].

---

**¶4:** Upon this composite form of hereditary evil there had been stamped the impress of every momentary state and every recurring interval, the impress of every completed state and every periodic change and every full cycle, the impression of all discrete knowledges and all the configurations of cyclical spiritual order [GAP-4: the spiritual sense requires completion of the catalogue of impressed spiritual influences]. This composite evil came into existence from all these influences and was precipitated from their active force and cast into the general repository of natural cognition. The representations, impressions, appearances, doctrines, and intentions of [GAP-5: the spiritual sense requires all the governing spiritual powers of the cyclical order] were sealed upon the form of that composite evil, because it is the consolidated residue of them all. Consequently, every particular knowledge that becomes active, and every configuration of cyclical order that revolves: for one it serves as provocation, and for another as confirmation.

---

**¶5:** This composite evil was precipitated into the repository of natural cognition in the way that spiritual influx might descend like rain into the midst of the general mass of knowing. It was directed entirely by the force and governance of angelic ministries. It was swept down to the process of breaking and reformation, the place where it had been constituted in the original ordering of all spiritual states; and the repository of natural cognition also conceived and gave form to it [GAP-6: the spiritual sense requires the repository's active role in gestating the form of evil], for its part [GAP-7: the spiritual sense requires the repository acting as] the principal formative and constituting power. It sculpted this evil into a definite likeness of the whole, this form being more transformed than any other rejected element within the repository.

---

**¶6:** This process is comparable to a formative power that takes the discrete persuasions stamped upon many separate cognitions and subjects them to the fire of self-love, and refashions them [GAP-8: REVIEW — to a single] unified form. These innumerable persuasions and innumerable appearances [GAP-9: REVIEW — are perfected] and constitute a single composite body [GAP-10: the spiritual sense requires completion of the analogy — one proprium from all rejected elements].

---

**¶7:** This is also the case with the composite form of hereditary evil, which was shaped and given definite form by the force of the ruling love of self within it, from the many doctrines and intentions that are the refuse of the entire cycle of providential order.

---

**¶8:** The archetype of this composite evil was permitted to exist for three purposes within the Divine providence.

---

**¶9:** The first: that the cycle of spiritual states would be relieved and purified of the burden within it. In the same way that the higher degrees of the mind were purified and relieved of the burden of the three containing forms of evil, so it was done also to the cyclical order of states, that it too might be relieved and purified of the burden and refuse accumulated within it.

---

**¶10:** The second: that the composite evil might serve as a fetter and a confinement upon the cycle of spiritual states and the configurations bound to it — so that when those influences seek to ascend and dominate what is above, the composite evil drags them back as by an unbreakable bond, and they cannot ascend; and when the powers of the cyclical order would devise something deceitful and it enters their intention to descend into the natural mind, they cannot descend because of the fixed restraint nailed to the cycle upon the {GAP-11: the spiritual sense requires the boundary or foundation} of the higher degrees. This is one restraint. However, the other — because of the ceaseless angelic guardians set over it — the cycle is turned perpetually.

---

**¶11:** The third purpose: that the spiritual influx, the truths, and the loves that issue from the circuit of the general repository of natural cognition, and the streams of truth that flow upon the surface of the natural mind and return into the repository, and the influx from the spiritual world that reaches the natural plane, and all the refuse and regenerative life that descend into it — the repository of natural cognition serves as a dwelling-place and gathering-place for all of these.

---

**¶12:** As for all the spiritual life and vitality that descends into the repository, and the breath that the composite evil draws into itself so as to agitate the mass of cognition — [GAP-12: the spiritual sense requires description of the resulting disturbance yielding] a fullness and a [GAP-13: the spiritual sense requires a complementary quality — perhaps a constriction or saturation] that arises between its activity [GAP-14: the spiritual sense requires a process of separation that would] purify; but the repository [GAP-15: the spiritual sense requires the final disposition of the repository — either its continued containment or eventual purification].

---

*Note on ¶12:* The extensive lacunae in this final paragraph resist full translation. The spiritual trajectory appears to describe how the composite evil's restless activity within the general mass of natural cognition paradoxically serves the Divine providence by agitating the contents toward separation — so that what is living can be purified from what is dead — but the gaps prevent confident reconstruction of the complete spiritual process.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: After the Living Spirit constructed things and the worlds, he came up and set himself upon this earth. He gave a sign to the King of Glory, who turned the three wheels and caused the wheels that are found [to turn] up above all the mountains; he spread forth the wind to them, he breathed on them, he stirred them up, he washed the earth with the waters. And the waste and the accretion of the three vessels, they of water and of Darkness and of fire, which had been discharged upon the earth, he gathered them and deposited them in the sea that is within the walls and the vessels; because of this sea waters are salty. For they have received salt and bitterness from the washing out and cleansing of the three vessels.

When the Father of Life came, rising in his ascent to the heights, he discharged the wheel of the stars; he washed it out and loosened all the sediment that was in it. He cast it down to this great inner sea like [the mud] of the mountain. And that waste, the sediment of the washing out of the wheel, he cast it down and mixed it in with the sea waters. Its own Thought collected it together; and the Thought gathered the waste together in this way. It made it fast and fixed it [into a single body]

The sea giant had stamped upon him the seal of the seconds and the hours, the seal of the days and months and years, the impression of the stars and the signs of the zodiac [and the decans] He came into existence from them and was discharged from their power and cast into the sea. The images and the seals and aspects and doctrines and counsels of [the stars and the zodiac] were sealed upon the body of that giant, because he is the residue of them all. Consequently, each star that will shine, and each sign of the zodiac that will turn: of one he shall be its inducement, and of another its confirmation.

He was discharged into the sea like this, the way a cloud might discharge rainwater into the midst of the sea. They compelled him totally through the action of the power and the helmsmanship of the angels. He was swept down to the mill, the place where he was constructed in the setting up of the universe; and the sea also conceived him [and bore him] for its part [shaped him] it being his chief sculptor and chief craftsman. It sculpted him in a likeness, he being changed more than the other residue of the sea bodies.

This matter is comparable with a craftsman who might take the stamped impressions of many coins and cast them on the fire, and mould them [to a single] image. These thousands of impressions and thousands of shapes [are perfected] and make a single body [from them all]
This is also the case with the sea giant, who too was moulded and sculpted by the power of the Lust inside him from many doctrines and counsels that belong to the residue of the wheel of the sphere.
The archetype of the giant was constructed for three things.

The first: That the sphere would be relieved and purified of the burden present in it. In the same way that the ten firmaments were purified and relieved of the burden of the three vessels; so was it also done to the sphere, that it too might be relieved and purified of the burden and the waste inside it.

The second: That he might add a fetter and a prison to the wheel and the signs of the zodiac that are bound to it, so that when they wish to go up above, you can find the sea giant dragging them back as by an iron fetter, and they are unable to go up; and when the powers of the wheel would take a decision on a guileful thing, and it enters their mind to come down to the earth, they are not able to descend because of this stake that is nailed to the wheel upon the [boundary] of the firmaments. This is one. However, this other one, because of its sleepless watchers that are set over it, it is turned all the time.

The third thing: That the wind and the water and the fire that gush from the circuit of the sea, and the rivers that flow upon the face of the earth discharging into the sea, and the rainwaters that come to ground, and the waste and rebirth that come down to it; that sea will be a hostel and gathering place for all of these.

As for all the power and the life that comes down to the sea, and in the breath that the sea giant will breathe and draw it into him that he might disturb the sea [and bring about] fullness and a [constriction] becomes between his movement [and would separate and] purify; but the sea [gathers them all within it]

fills.explanation: The King of Glory "turned the three wheels and caused the wheels that are found to turn up above all the mountains" — the spiritual sense requires the cycles of providential order to be set into active operation, and "to turn" is the natural action of wheels in Manichaean cosmology.

The sediment from the purification of the wheel was cast down into the sea "like the mud of the mountain" — a natural simile for washed-down residue precipitated from an elevated source into lower waters, matching the spiritual sense of refuse precipitated from the elevated state.

The Thought gathered and fixed the waste "into a single body," matching the spiritual sense of fixation into a definite and enduring form — the consolidated proprium that becomes the sea giant described in the next paragraph.

In the Kephalaia's standard astrological catalogue, the signs of the zodiac are consistently paired with the decans (the thirty-six ruler-stars); this completes the catalogue of impressed celestial influences stamped upon the sea giant.

The spiritual sense requires all the governing powers of the cyclical order; "the stars and the zodiac" names the celestial powers whose doctrines and counsels were sealed on the giant, directly echoing the terminology used earlier in the same paragraph.

The sea "conceived" the giant and naturally "bore him" — completing the gestation metaphor and expressing the repository's active role in bringing forth the composite form of evil, as the spiritual reading requires.

The sea for its part "shaped him," expressing the repository's active formative role before being identified as "chief sculptor and chief craftsman" — the spiritual reading requires the repository acting as the principal constituting power.

The editor's fill is confirmed: the craftsman moulds many stamped impressions "to a single" image, correctly expressing the consolidation of innumerable discrete forms into one unified form — the proprium from all rejected elements.

The editor's fill is confirmed: the thousands of impressions and shapes "are perfected" — brought to completion and fulfillment as a single composite body, consistent with the Coptic verb ϫⲱⲕ (to complete/perfect) commonly used in the Kephalaia for processes reaching their final state.
The analogy concludes with one body made "from them all" — one proprium consolidated from all rejected elements, directly echoing ¶4's phrase "he is the residue of them all."

The stake (sea giant) is nailed to the wheel upon the "boundary" of the firmaments — the junction between the cyclical order and the higher degrees, where the fixed restraint of consolidated evil prevents the discrete powers from crossing between degrees.

The sea giant disturbs the sea "and brings about" a fullness — bridging the disturbance to its result, as the spiritual reading requires description of the yielding/producing of the state that follows.

The complementary quality to "fullness" is "constriction" — the alternating expansion and compression caused by the giant's breathing, matching the spiritual reading's suggested pair and Swedenborg's teaching on the paired states of expansion and constriction in the natural mind.

The spiritual reading requires a process of separation that would purify; the giant's agitation creates movement that "would separate and purify" — the dual process of separating living elements from dead refuse before purification can occur.

The chapter concludes with the sea's essential function restated: despite the purifying agitation, "the sea gathers them all within it" — echoing ¶11's description of the sea as "a hostel and gathering place for all of these," affirming the repository's role of continued containment.
